b3477d55db68: Travelife is all-in-one management software for travel agencies, tour operators and tourism professionals. This 100% cloud ERP solution centralizes every operation on a single platform: bookings, B2B/B2C sales, invoicing, accounting, CRM and payment tracking.
757bec0b0aaf: Thanks to its multi-supplier API and GDS integrations, the platform automates processes, reduces errors and improves productivity.
af38eebf8789: Our solution is designed for travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs / inbound agencies, agency networks, OTAs and self-employed professionals in the tourism sector. Thanks to its cloud architecture and flexible modules, Travelife adapts equally well to small businesses and to multi-agency organizations operating internationally.
079f623b230d: Our solution offers a complete package to manage every activity of a travel agency. The platform includes an ERP for sales and operations management, a smart, connected CRM (Travelife Smart CRM), an invoicing and accounting module, a payment and cash-flow tracking system, as well as a B2B platform and a connected B2C website.
9ca6aff66605: The platform also connects to the leading GDSs (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport…) and to suppliers via API for online booking of flights, hotels and transfers. It also handles offline bookings such as contracted hotels, visas, activities and tailor-made tours, all centralized in a single system.
4a96a63e4159: How long has Travelife been around and how many agencies use it?
79754e3e6af6: Travelife was founded in 2013 in Casablanca. Since then, the solution has become one of the leading technology platforms for travel professionals in Morocco: more than 200 travel agencies trust it today, in Morocco and internationally.
be1bca1fea69: The software was recognized at the World Summit Awards (Morocco’s best digital solution) and received the “Best Travel Agency Software Company – Morocco” award at the African Excellence Awards 2025. Travelife is also listed with Maroc PME under the GO SIYAHA program.
13b82f6a0194: What is the difference between Travelife and a generic ERP like Odoo for a travel agency?
a4f7ed517623: Travelife is software built 100% for the industry, designed from day one for travel agencies, whereas a generic ERP has to be adapted and configured for this sector. Travelife natively includes everything an agency needs: multi-service travel booking files (flights, hotels, transfers, visas, tours), connection to GDSs and suppliers via API, vouchers and rooming lists, commission management and automatic calculation of the VAT on margin specific to travel agencies.
e670ffdc432b: Your teams work in a tool that speaks their language, with no custom development. To learn more, read our article Travelife or Odoo for a travel agency.
